summary: Right-footed soccer side volley at contact: kicking leg swung round near horizontal at hip height, trunk leaning far away from the ball, both arms raised for balance.

rules.why: trunk leans far away from the ball; lean grows with ball height
arms raised near horizontal for balance (abduction over 80 deg in jumping volleys)
ball met between knee and waist height

text.action: a soccer player hitting a right-footed side volley, the ball met at hip height beside the body
text.core: Left support foot planted, left knee bent; trunk leaning far to the left, away from the ball; right kicking leg swung round and raised near horizontal, knee slightly bent, foot flat and turned over the top of the ball with the toes pointed; both arms raised out to the sides for balance; hips turning toward the goal.
text.gaze: Eyes on the ball at contact.
cues: lean the trunk away from the ball
swing the kicking leg round with the hip turned in
keep the foot flat over the top of the ball to keep the shot down
kinetic: grass flying off the support boot
shirt and shorts pulled by the rotation, motion blur on the kicking leg
avoid: kicking leg drawn as a front kick

sources.cite: Sugi, Nunome, Tamura & Iga, ISBS 2017: volley vs instep kick (more knee flexion, trunk lean and pelvis rotation) - search extract
Shan & Zhang 2011 / Shan 2022: trunk side lean and pelvis twist increase with ball height
Shan et al. 2020, Applied Sciences 10:4785: jumping side volley, trunk twist about 40 deg, shoulder abduction over 80 deg
ISBS 2020: successful vs failed volleys (foot over the top of the ball keeps the shot down)
